description.value: Jack Lonsdale's is North Vancouver's original public house, established in 1988 on Lonsdale Avenue. It offers a full food menu of burgers, salads, and signature pizzas alongside an impressive drink selection featuring 24 craft beers on tap, 8 wines on tap, and prohibition-era cocktails. An attached liquor store is also on-site, and all ages are welcome until 9pm when accompanied by an adult.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and active, confirming the business is open. The website corroborates the OSM phone number (604-986-7333) and URL, but reveals a more complete address including unit number 127 not present in OSM. The site mentions 'Online Ordering and Delivery' confirming takeout, and describes a full food and drink menu with burgers, salads, pizzas, 24 craft beers on tap, and 8 wines on tap. No explicit mentions of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities were found in the website content.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '1433 Lonsdale Avenue' with no unit number, but the website consistently shows '127-1433 Lonsdale Ave' — unit 127 should be added to the OSM record.
